annotations.title: Check where a dataset is shown

description: Tell the Atlas which public page shows a published dataset, and check it now: the page's HTML must carry the data and a visible link to the dataset page (not in a comment, iframe or noscript). Re-checked daily; the state shows in atlas_dataset_get. Nothing on the page is changed. Needs a signed-in inite.ai account: a guest call answers 401 and starts the OAuth flow.
name: atlas_dataset_placement
title: Check where a dataset is shown
